people.name: Baruch
people.line: A man who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.

people.name: Eliashib
people.line: High priest during Nehemiah's time, involved in rebuilding Jerusalem's wall

translations.web: After him, Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired another portion, from the turning of the wall to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
translations.bsb: Next to him, Baruch son of Zabbai diligently repaired another section, from the angle to the doorway of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
translations.kjv: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece, from the turning of the wall unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
